rationale: The stock gapped down ~6.7% at the open and has since recovered to the upper 89% of today's range, sitting right at the 9-EMA with price compressed into a very tight band ($19.21–$19.27) over the last five minutes on declining volume. The ATR is extremely small ($0.044) relative to the gap, suggesting momentum has stalled after the initial recovery move, and with SPY down and VIXY elevated there is no clear directional edge — entering long near the day's high after a large gap-down recovery carries unfavorable risk/reward, while shorting into a stock that has already absorbed heavy selling and bounced 3%+ off the low is equally unattractive.
